items.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
items.description: The three leaders will meet together for the first time on Thursday during a closely-watched summit.

items.title: William and Kate meet Indian Prime Minister Modi in New Delhi
items.description: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which has also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize

items.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
items.description: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.

items.title: Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage
items.description: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.

items.title: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to be US Speaker of the House
items.description: The nomination sets him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber when Democrats take control of the House in January.

items.title: Parents jailed for torture and death of four-year-old girl in France in 1987
items.description: Inass Touloub's body was found along the A10 road in 1987, bearing marks of abuse, and was not identified until 2018.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a masterpiece, say critics
items.description: Critics have their say as to whether GTA 6, the most anticipated video game of all time, lives up to the hype.

items.title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
items.description: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.

items.title: Bancroft sandpaper claims heap pressure on Cummins
items.description: Cameron Bancroft claims the whole Australia team knew about the 2018 sandpaper plot in explosive revelations that will heap pressure on current captain Pat Cummins.

items.title: British hacker who stole $11m through text message scheme jailed for six years in US
items.description: Tyler Buchanan, from Dundee, was a member of the notorious Scattered Spider group and began hacking when he was a teenager.

items.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
items.description: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

items.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways
items.description: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.
